propositions: Expected and auto-handled tickets-branch push contention failures surface at WARNING with wording that primes LLM agents to investigate, burning tokens on non-issues.

Mid-retry transient transport fault notices and the unpushed-backlog suffix (containing bare ..HEAD) escalate the appearance of state failure across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract.
Under normal concurrent-writer load, lost-contention races, transient retries, and routine static backlog counts must emit nothing at INFO or above (DEBUG at most) rather than WARNING/INFO.
Policy declines (hook rejected, GH013, branch protection), strict-mode failures, and proven-GROWING backlogs must remain WARNING/raise to preserve operator-actionable signals.

Demoting expected-case emissions from INFO to DEBUG and renaming the unpushed-backlog suffix to explicitly state the tickets branch and self-healing contract removes noise without changing push behavior, retry logic, or durability markers.
